title: Plan AM: AI E-commerce Product Copy
summary: Product points → page structure → copy generation → visuals → conversion tuning
scenario: For e-commerce operators and merchants writing high-converting product page copy and benefit graphics.

steps.title: Product selling points
steps.detail: Gather specs, materials, certifications and use cases, then distill 3-5 core selling points and differentiators. Have the model compare competitor copy to find what only you can claim.
steps.tips: Write points as 'pain → solution → proof' and give each screen of the page one point to own.

steps.title: Page structure
steps.detail: Build the page skeleton: hook above the fold → pain scenarios → selling points → technical details → brand trust → after-sales. Turn the skeleton into a per-screen copy checklist.
steps.tips: The first screen must say what problem it solves within three seconds — dwell time lives or dies there.

steps.title: Copy generation
steps.detail: Generate screen by screen — headline, subhead, selling-point copy, spec tables and FAQ. Watch platform-banned words and superlatives; dietary supplements need extra care.
steps.tips: Write benefit-first headlines, e.g. 'heats in 3 seconds, no more cold-water washing'.

steps.title: Visuals
steps.detail: Use real product shots or 3D renders for main images; generate lifestyle scenes in Midjourney and lay out typography in Canva. Make sure images and copy tell the same story.
steps.tips: Keep benefit graphics image-heavy with little text, one point per screen, easy to read on mobile.

steps.title: Conversion tuning
steps.detail: After launch, watch dwell time, add-to-cart rate and refund reasons; have the model diagnose copy issues and propose A/B variants. Change one screen at a time and validate before rolling out.
steps.tips: Optimize the first screen and benefit graphics first — they move conversion the most.

pitfalls.title: Writing a spec sheet, not a page
pitfalls.detail: Nobody reads parameter lists; reorder and rephrase around user benefits.

pitfalls.title: Overclaiming
pitfalls.detail: Superlatives and efficacy claims get listings pulled and penalized; back every point with real evidence.

pitfalls.title: Copy/visual mismatch
pitfalls.detail: Copy says A, image shows B — buyers feel tricked; align both.

pitfalls.title: Shipping without testing
pitfalls.detail: Conversion is decided by data; keep A/B testing after launch instead of finalizing on gut feel.
